subgroup_flags.classification_notes: ards_subgroup mixed: 10 AE-ILD-UIP (non-ARDS fibrotic) plus 10 primary ARDS controls. timing: measurements within 24 h from admission, so early_within_48h. obesity: BMI was a matching variable but no BMI values reported in the main text (in supplement eTable 1, not provided). ptp_target_subgroups: Pes-guided titration to positive end-expiratory PL via absolute subtraction approach.

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: Checked against all clusters in COHORTS.md. Registration NCT05098717 (retrospectively registered) does not match any other record's registration; enrolment August 2016 to July 2022 at the RICU of University Hospital of Modena, Italy, a centre not named in any cluster; population is AE-ILD-UIP with matched ARDS controls, not an ARDS-only cohort. No overlap concluded.
unclear_items: outcomes[EL].paired_effects: p-value for EL at PEEPTITRATED vs ZEEP in AE-ILD-UIP is 0.004 in the Abstract and Fig. 1 panel A but 0.04 in the Results text ('p = 0.04 and p < 0.0001'); recorded the Abstract/figure value 0.004 and flagged the discrepancy.
outcomes[PEEP, PEEPTITRATED].effect_estimates: Table 1 gives p = 0.03 for between-group PEEP at PEEPTITRATED but the text states p < 0.001; both recorded.
outcomes[pO2].data[].unit: Table 1 prints the unit for pO2 (and pCO2, pH) as 'cmH2O', an obvious typographical error for mmHg; recorded verbatim as printed without conversion.

intervention.ptp_computation.method: coded absolute_pes_subtraction from the Talmor-style description, but the exact PL computation (Paw − Pes vs elastance-derived) is described only in Additional file 1 Supplement, which was not provided.

intervention.balloon_calibration: no balloon filling or calibration detail in the main text; the Supplement (referencing Chiumello occlusion-test methods, ref 10) was not provided, so coded not_reported.
intervention.peep_titration_target.end_expiratory_ptp_target_low_cmh2o: target stated only as 'positive PL,EE'; lower bound 0 inferred.
population baseline characteristics (age, sex, BMI, APACHE II, PaO2/FiO2) are in Additional file 1: eTable 1, not provided; all null here.
design.randomised: coded false; the study is a retrospective matched-control physiologic study with no randomisation described.

mortality outcome: ARDS-control mortality not reported; only AE-ILD-UIP deaths (10/10) stated. Denominator for the mortality entry uses the ild_zeep arm label as the cohort has no dedicated single-group label.
adults_18_plus: explicit age > 18 criterion present, so coded yes without inference.
data_only_in_figure: Individual paired values of EL, PL,EE, PL,EI and ΔPL at ZEEP, PEEPLOW and PEEPTITRATED for both groups (Fig. 1, panels A–H); only p-values are printed in text/figure.
extraction_flags.general_notes: COHORTS.md flagged this study at full-text screening: index population is acute exacerbation of ILD-UIP (n=10) with 10 matched ARDS controls, not an ARDS population; included because esophageal-pressure-guided PEEP titration was actually applied and clinically relevant physiologic outcomes are reported. Paired within-group p-values for Ecw, Etot and ΔPaw across PEEP phases are not reported in text or figure; only EL, PL,EE, PL,EI and ΔPL have Fig. 1 panels. No schema field exists for the between-group interaction p-values other than as omnibus paired_effects entries; recorded there.
